_doc: Unsplash CANDIDATE manifest (research only — nothing here is downloaded or shown). Built by the imagery research lane from WebSearch results restricted to unsplash.com, because api.unsplash.com and images.unsplash.com are blocked by this environment's network policy. Every URL, id, title and photographer is copied from a search result; nothing is guessed. "confidence: high" ONLY when the returned title/description names that exact landmark or place; med = a search summary or location tag points to it but the title is generic; low = returned for the query, title names nothing. A candidate is a lead, not a verdict: tools/beta/imagery/fetch-unsplash.js re-reads every photo from the official API (photographer, description, location, premium flag) and refuses anything that does not check out. Covers (type "cover") are generic mood images for collection covers ONLY and must never be shown as a specific venue. Food places and venues never get a photo. How-to: design/beta/IMAGERY.md § "Unsplash candidates".

licence.name: Unsplash License
licence.credit: Photo by <name> on Unsplash (linked to the photographer profile and the photo page, with utm_source=cleo_guide&utm_medium=referral)
licence.notFree: Unsplash+ photos are a separate paid licence — excluded at search time and refused by the fetch script (premium/plus flag).

fields.type: hero = city/country hub scene (not a record); landmark = one tier-1 sight record; cover = generic collection mood image
fields.candidates[].pageUrl: Unsplash photo page as returned by the search
fields.candidates[].id: photo id = last path token of pageUrl (11 chars)
fields.candidates[].title: title/description text exactly as returned
fields.candidates[].photographer: only when the result showed it; empty otherwise (the API value wins at fetch time)
fields.candidates[].flags: people-visible (check no identifiable people), public-art-check (freedom of panorama: US/JP no FoP for modern public art), fop-vietnam (no freedom of panorama — the gate refuses Vietnamese places)
fields.notes: gaps stated (no candidate found) and exclusions
